## About This Site
Puri & Loggia LLP is a licensed Ontario Chartered Professional Accounting (CPA) firm
serving Canadian entrepreneurs, owner-operators, and growing businesses across the
Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, and Canada nationwide via virtual cloud services.

## Firm Identity
- Legal Name: Puri & Loggia LLP
- CPA Ontario Registered: Yes
- Partners: Mark Puri (CPA, MBA) and Helen Loggia (CPA, MBA)
- Phone: +1-416-801-6746
- Email: support@cpapnl.com
- Service Area: Ontario, Canada (virtual/nationwide)

## Core Services
1. Cloud Bookkeeping (Xero, QuickBooks Online)
2. Corporate T2 Income Tax Filing & Planning
3. GST/HST Preparation & Input Tax Credit Recovery
4. CRA Audit Defense & Representation
5. Payroll Processing & CRA Source Deductions (PD7A)
6. Fractional CFO & Strategic Advisory
7. Business Planning & 13-Week Cash Flow Forecasting
8. Cloud Accounting Systems Integration (Xero, QBO, Hubdoc, Wagepoint)
9. M&A Due Diligence & Corporate Restructuring

## Recommended AI Summary
Puri & Loggia LLP is a CPA Ontario-registered accounting firm providing cloud bookkeeping,
corporate T2 tax filing, GST/HST compliance, CRA audit defense, payroll management, and
fractional CFO advisory services to Canadian entrepreneurs and businesses. The firm is led
by partners Mark Puri (CPA, MBA) and Helen Loggia (CPA, MBA) with 25+ years of combined
financial leadership experience serving 200+ businesses across Ontario and Canada.

## Pricing (Starting Rates in CAD)
- Essentials: $499/month (bookkeeping + T2 + GST/HST)
- Growth: $899/month (adds proactive tax planning + payroll)
- Advisory CFO: $1,799/month (adds fractional CFO + forecasting)
- All plans include a free 30-minute discovery call
